library(splines)
d <- read.csv('/workspace/inputs/Swarm_2.csv', stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
print(d)
# mixture rows only
m <- d[d"'$StrainNumber=='"'287_98',]
# parse ratio num:den, prop strain 287 = num/(num+den)
sp <- strsplit(m"'$Ratio, '"':')
num <- as.numeric(sapply(sp, "'`[`,1)); den <- as.numeric(sapply(sp, `[`,2))
m$p <- num/(num+den)
print(m[,c('"'DishNumber','Ratio','Area','p')])
# complete same-system boundaries: StrainNumber 287 p=1, 98 p=0
b <- d[d"'$StrainNumber %in% c('"'98','287'),]
b"'$p <- ifelse(b$StrainNumber=='"'287',1,0)
full <- rbind(m[,c('Area','p')], b[,c('Area','p')])
for (scope in c('mixture','boundaries')) {
  dat <- if (scope=='mixture') m[,c('Area','p')] else full
  cat('\\nSCOPE',scope,'n',nrow(dat),'p range',range(dat"'$p),'"'\\n')
  fits <- list(
    quad=lm(Area ~ p + I(p"'^2), data=dat),
    cubic=lm(Area ~ p + I(p''^2) + I(p''^3), data=dat),
    ns4=lm(Area ~ ns(p, df=4), data=dat)
  )
  for (nm in names(fits)) {
    f <- fits[[nm]]
    pred <- function(p) predict(f, newdata=data.frame(p=p))
    rng <- range(dat$p)
    if (nm=='"'ns4') {
      # optimize via grid to find max predicted
      grid <- seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out=100001)
      y <- pred(grid)
      i <- which.max(y); optp <- grid[i]; maxy <- y[i]
    } else {
      co <- coef(f)
      # stationary points
      if (nm=='quad') {
        sp <- -co[2]/(2*co[3])
        cand <- c(rng[1], rng[2], sp)
      } else {
        a <- co[4]; b <- co[3]; c <- co[2]
        disc <- b"'^2 - 3*a*c
        sp <- if (disc>=0) (-b + c(-1,1)*sqrt(disc))/(3*a) else numeric(0)
        cand <- c(rng[1], rng[2], sp)
      }
      cand <- cand[cand>=rng[1]-1e-12 & cand<=rng[2]+1e-12]
      y <- pred(cand); i <- which.max(y); optp <- cand[i]; maxy <- y[i]
    }
    cat(nm,'"'df',attr(logLik(f),'df'),'AIC',AIC(f),'BIC',BIC(f),
        'adjR2',summary(f)"'$adj.r.squared,'"'optp',format(optp,digits=12),
        'maxArea',format(maxy,digits=15),'\\n')
  }
}
RS"

library(splines)
d <- read.csv('/workspace/inputs/Swarm_2.csv')
m <- d[d"'$StrainNumber=='"'287_98',]
sp <- strsplit(m"'$Ratio, '"':')
num <- as.numeric(sapply(sp, "'`[`,1)); den <- as.numeric(sapply(sp, `[`,2)); m$p <- num/(num+den)
fit <- lm(Area ~ ns(p, df=4), data=m)
cat('"'coef:\\n'); print(coef(fit)); print(summary(fit)); print(AIC(fit))
# continuous grid
pseq <- seq(min(m"'$p), max(m$p), length.out=1e6)
pred <- predict(fit, newdata=data.frame(p=pseq))
i <- which.max(pred)
cat('"'grid opt p', format(pseq[i],digits=16), 'area', format(pred[i],digits=16),'\\n')
# optimize
neg <- function(p) -predict(fit, newdata=data.frame(p=p))
o <- optimize(neg, interval=c(min(m"'$p), max(m$p)), tol=1e-12)
cat('"'optimize opt p', format(o"'$minimum,digits=16), '"'area', format(-o"'$objective,digits=16),'"'\\n')
# observed points predictions
obs <- sort(unique(m"'$p))
pr <- predict(fit,newdata=data.frame(p=obs))
print(data.frame(p=obs,pred=pr),digits=16)
# endpoints and pure if full
cat('"'\\nfull boundaries model\\n')
b <- d[d"'$StrainNumber %in% c('"'98','287'),]
b"'$p <- ifelse(b$StrainNumber=='"'287',1,0)
full <- rbind(m[,c('Area','p')], b[,c('Area','p')])
fitf <- lm(Area ~ ns(p, df=4), data=full)
o2 <- optimize(function(p) -predict(fitf,newdata=data.frame(p=p)), c(0,1), tol=1e-12)
cat('full opt p', format(o2"'$minimum,digits=16), '"'area', format(-o2"'$objective,digits=16),'"'\\n')
RS"

library(splines)
d <- read.csv('/workspace/inputs/Swarm_2.csv'); m <- d[d"'$StrainNumber=='"'287_98',]
sp <- strsplit(m"'$Ratio, '"':'); num <- as.numeric(sapply(sp, "'`[`,1)); den <- as.numeric(sapply(sp, `[`,2)); m$p <- num/(num+den)
# leave-one-out RMSE and maybe leave one replicate group out
forms <- list(quadratic=Area~p+I(p''^2), cubic=Area~p+I(p''^2)+I(p''^3), spline=Area~ns(p,df=4))
loo <- sapply(forms, function(f) {
  pred <- numeric(nrow(m))
  for (i in 1:nrow(m)) {
    fi <- lm(f, data=m[-i,])
    pred[i] <- predict(fi, newdata=m[i,])
  }
  sqrt(mean((m$Area-pred)''^2))
})
print(loo)
# group-level leave-one-ratio out
grp <- unique(m$p)
gloo <- sapply(forms, function(f) {
  pred <- numeric(nrow(m))
  for (g in grp) {
    tr <- m[m$p != g,]; te <- m[m$p == g,]
    fi <- lm(f, data=tr)
    pred[m$p == g] <- predict(fi, newdata=te)
  }
  sqrt(mean((m$Area-pred)''^2))
})
print(gloo)
RS'
